gate.rule: Every integrity-verified candidate that passes geometric validation participates in scoring. Confirmed invalid or inconclusive validation is not admitted.

unavailable_measurement_policy: After declared calculation paths fail, preserve measured_score=null and award zero credit for that metric, without weight renormalization. Label total policy_lower_bound; disclose missing-credit range, coverage, and errors. This is not a measured zero or a full-quality score.
notes: Validation is independent of reference metric qualification. Mass uses robust integration, face_match uses bidirectional surface coverage, section uses a reference-frozen bilateral definition. Fixed world mm; rank eligibility remains false.
